items: Visual inspection, rust stains polished off and treated with rust protection

Certain steel parts in the operating mechanism have manganese surface 
 treatment and are then dipped in a rust inhibiting oil. This applies to 
 latches, gear wheels, parts of the link system, etc.

The closing and opening springs are rust inhibited by painting with 
 two-component paint .

When supplied, the operating mechanism is equipped with anti-corrosion vapour 
 phase inhibitors.These inhibitors are only for protection during transport. 
 Despite the extensive rust inhibitor treatment, minor corrosion can occur 
 after some years especially if the circuit-breaker is located in a strongly 
 corrosive environment. Rust spots should be cleaned and new rust inhibitor 
 applied with a brush or spray.

sections.text:
The recommended rust inhibitor is Grease ,,G,, or Tectyl 506, Grease ,,G,, 
 USED for greasing sealing rings and crevice corrosion protection. (Grease 
 ,,G,, Lubricants 1HSB445409-1), Tectyl 506 forms a waxy protective skin when 
 it dries and therefore it must not be sprayed into bearings and mechanisms or 
 on to gear-wheels and chains.

The ball, roller and needle bearings in the operating mechanism are 
 permanently lubricated and require no maintenance. Lubrication is therefore 
 limited to shafts in the latches of the operating mechanism and the worm gear 
 in the drive unit with grease ,,M,,.

Grease ,,M,, is Low-temperature grease for long-term and permanent 
 lubrication of worm gears, spur gears and other machine elements. Counteracts 
 wear and corrosion, (Grease ,,M,, special Lubricants 1HSB445409-1).

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed from 
three to six years or 2,000 mechanical CLOSE/OPEN operations 
as indicated by Y3:6 in the title block
Competence Requirement:
Personnel authorized by ABB to carry out assembly, commissioning and maintenance 
work
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah Kamel Mostafa (HV-Dep. Manager), tested by eng. Sahar Mohamed Ali, 
accepted by eng. 
Sayed Mahmoud 
Hussein Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd 
El-Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady head sector of Ataka PS.
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety belts 
 ... etc.
Isolate and ground both sides of CB.
Switch off and isolate the control circuits i.e. de-energized
Isolate and ground both sides of CB.
Switch off and isolate the control circuits i.e. de-energized
Closing springs discharged, circuit breaker in open position and grounded.
There is danger of falling off the top of the CB stack when cleaning 
 insulators or checking connections wear your safety belt.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool kit.
Cleaning tools.
Safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety harnesses 
 ... etc.
Thermovision camera.
Electronic timer.
Voltage indicator.
Work to be Carried Out
Important Note:
All HPL circuit 
 breakers are completely hose-proof, i.e. circuit breakers in operation can 
 be cleaned with high-pressure water without any risk of water entering the 
 circuit breaker and causing damage to essential parts.
Ocular Inspection
Clean the circuit breaker insulators from salt and other contaminant deposits. 
 The time interval for cleaning depends on the local conditions.
Check external cleaning , heater element function, gas pressure, valves and 
 drainage holes .
A new or overhauled circuit breaker should be checked for tightness by reading 
 the density monitors after about 1 month and then at 1-2 year intervals in 
 connection with the regular ocular inspection.
Rating Plates
Make a note of the serial number.
Operation Counter
Make a note of the number of operations.
Visual Inspection in Operating Mechanism
Look for loose bolts and nuts, oil leaks from dashpots. If leakage replace the 
 complete dashpot
Corrosion Inspection and Rust Protection
Visual inspection, rust stains polished off and treated with rust protection
Certain steel parts in the operating mechanism have manganese surface 
 treatment and are then dipped in a rust inhibiting oil. This applies to 
 latches, gear wheels, parts of the link system, etc.
The closing and opening springs are rust inhibited by painting with 
 two-component paint .
When supplied, the operating mechanism is equipped with anti-corrosion vapour 
 phase inhibitors.These inhibitors are only for protection during transport. 
 Despite the extensive rust inhibitor treatment, minor corrosion can occur 
 after some years especially if the circuit-breaker is located in a strongly 
 corrosive environment. Rust spots should be cleaned and new rust inhibitor 
 applied with a brush or spray.
Important Note:
The recommended rust inhibitor is Grease ,,G,, or Tectyl 506, Grease ,,G,, 
 USED for greasing sealing rings and crevice corrosion protection. (Grease 
 ,,G,, Lubricants 1HSB445409-1), Tectyl 506 forms a waxy protective skin when 
 it dries and therefore it must not be sprayed into bearings and mechanisms or 
 on to gear-wheels and chains.
Greasing
The ball, roller and needle bearings in the operating mechanism are 
 permanently lubricated and require no maintenance. Lubrication is therefore 
 limited to shafts in the latches of the operating mechanism and the worm gear 
 in the drive unit with grease ,,M,,.
Important Note:
Grease ,,M,, is Low-temperature grease for long-term and permanent 
 lubrication of worm gears, spur gears and other machine elements. Counteracts 
 wear and corrosion, (Grease ,,M,, special Lubricants 1HSB445409-1).
Thermovision Measurements
To be carried out at full load before the circuit-breaker is taken out of 
 service. The load current must be taken into consideration during the 
 measurements as well as large variations in the load current 3-4 hours before 
 the measurements.
Check the temperature rise of the external parts of the breaker unit. The 
 maximal allowed temperature difference between phases is 5 degrees .
Measurement Spring Charging
Measure the dimension between the spring bridge and frame foot 
 .
Operating Test
Operating test in combination with measurement of operating times
- Closing time < 65 ms - Opening time coil I 20 2 
 ms
- Opening time coil II 20 2ms
